purpose: Evaluate the current best horizon-weighted recurrent compact-latent student on the official LeWM PushT backend through the frozen predictor-level gate only.

research_question.primary: Can a shared h256 residual recurrent transition with predicted-latent feedback and fixed later-horizon weighting replace the expensive LeWM autoregressive predictor closely enough for planner-facing use?
research_question.mechanism: The student learns dense future LeWM CLS latents from the frozen official predictor, but rolls forward using its own predicted 192-D latent at every step. The only LeWM-specific additions are a shared 3-latent history adapter and raw packed-action projection.
research_question.unit_of_analysis: one held-out context x one fresh action-prefix seed block; candidates inside a block are nested measurements, not independent replicates
research_question.primary_comparison: student versus the read-only official LeWM teacher on identical contexts, candidate prefixes, teacher targets, objective, and held-out seeds
research_question.scope: action-conditioned predictor only; stop at the predictor-level gate

fast_lewm.comparison_boundary: Fast-LeWM is a retrained model-redesign baseline with a different multi-horizon predictor interface. This transfer experiment does not reproduce it, load its checkpoint, or claim a measured Fast-LeWM comparison.

evidence_boundary.dino_wm_transfer: The DINO-WM student result supplies the mechanism and gates; its weights, visual/proprio heads, patch-token dimensions, and DINO data are not reused here.

scope.observation_encoder_scope: out of scope; use cached official LeWM latent history for predictor timing
scope.predictor_scope: action-conditioned predictor only until predictor gate; no observation-encoder claim

student.name: horizon_weighted_compact_recurrent

architecture.history_adapter: one shared Linear(3*192,256) adapter over a rolling latest-3 LeWM latent window; at the official policy start H=1, repeat-left-pad the single current latent to length 3, then replace padded entries naturally as predictions are appended; no attention and no per-horizon copies
architecture.action_projection: Linear(10,256) on the official normalized raw packed action token
architecture.latent_update: one shared LayerNorm(256) and Linear(256,192) residual output
architecture.feedback: after each step, the predicted 192-D latent is appended to a rolling length-3 history and is used by the next step
architecture.parameter_count_expectation: approximately 0.78M trainable parameters; report the exact count from the implementation

minimal_lewm_adapters: latest-3 latent flattening adapter with deterministic repeat-left-padding for the official H=1 policy start
forbidden: teacher or source predictor module inside the student

teacher_targets.teacher: frozen official LeWM autoregressive predictor at the pinned source commit/checkpoint
teacher_targets.input: the same official H=1 current latent and the same five-token normalized packed action prefix; the teacher uses its native variable sequence lengths 1,2,3 while the student repeat-left-pads its fixed latest-3 adapter at the first two steps
teacher_targets.target: detached dense future 192-D CLS latents z_{t+1}...z_{t+5}
teacher_targets.collection: run the official teacher autoregressively for each fixed query row before student training; store only small manifests/targets required by the compute job
teacher_targets.goal: used only by the external official LeWM criterion during planner evaluation; never passed into the student

asset_contract.checkpoint: $STABLEWM_HOME/pusht/lewm/config.json and weights.pt, or the equivalent official object checkpoint resolved by the pinned LeWM loader

context_manifest.selection: deterministic CPU selection from valid single-current-frame anchors with at least 25 following primitive actions; record exact episode, timestep, current-frame ID, and logged future-action span in a manifest before training
context_manifest.insufficient_source_data: If the pinned dataset cannot supply the requested episode-disjoint contexts, fail preflight; do not duplicate contexts or silently change the split.
context_manifest.reuse: The same manifest is used by teacher target generation, training, held-out evaluation, and predictor timing.

action_query_slate.gaussian_std_rule: sqrt(variance_floor); frozen before the first training run
action_query_slate.generation: Create once with the frozen CPU action-slate seed. Gaussian slots are clipped to the official action range; the one-step CEM slot is generated using only the frozen official teacher objective.

context_schedule.generation: CPU permutation of the frozen train-context ordinals; consume eight consecutive contexts per update

seeds.cpu_generator_policy: Generate all manifests, slates, teacher targets, held-out candidates, and timing actions with explicit CPU generators before GPU transfer.

loss.per_horizon: 192-D latent MSE on the free-running predicted latent
loss.uniform_ablation: Optional single uniform-weight recurrent arm using the same manifest, schedule, initialization seed, and 1500 updates; do not expand to a multi-arm sweep.

stage_a_predictor_evaluation.role: primary predictor feasibility and planner-fidelity gate

heldout.candidate_bank: fixed before evaluation, identical for teacher and student, with official normalized action range and exact candidate order

stage_a_predictor_evaluation.objective: Use the unmodified official LeWM goal-distance/criterion implementation outside the student. The student remains goal-free.

latency.boundary: cached official H=1 current latent plus five normalized packed action tokens -> five-step predictor rollout; teacher history grows 1-to-3 and student uses deterministic repeat-left-padding before its rolling window is full

causality.procedure: For unchanged prefix lengths 1,2,3,4, alter only later packed action tokens and compare outputs through the unchanged prefix.

stage_b_official_lewm_cem.condition: DISABLED by the user for this experiment. Stop after the predictor-level gate and do not submit or execute an official-CEM benchmark.
stage_b_official_lewm_cem.role: deferred protocol reference only; not executed and not claimed
stage_b_official_lewm_cem.implementation: Use the pinned official stable-worldmodel CEM solver and PushT policy preprocessing. Replace only the candidate-cost predictor call with the trained student wrapper; preserve action sampling, criterion, top-k selection, mean/variance updates, callbacks, and RNG order.

official_solver.goal_embedding: encoded once by the frozen official LeWM policy and used only by the external criterion

required_metrics: returned first action and final action
stage_b_official_lewm_cem.latency_boundary: one complete official CEM solve from solve entry through returned action, including all 30 predictor iterations, sampling, criterion, top-k/update, and solver overhead; excludes environment interaction

viability_gates.integrity: teacher and student use identical fixed observations, goals, candidate RNG, solver config, and callback trace contract
viability_gates.decision: PASS only if integrity, first-action, terminal-elite, latency, memory, and finite-output requirements all pass; otherwise full_cem_viability is NO-GO.

stage_b_official_lewm_cem.interpretation: Candidate/elite/mean-var drift is reported per iteration even when the viability gate fails. Stage B does not establish closed-loop PushT success.

predictor_feasibility.comparison: student step1500 against the read-only official LeWM teacher
predictor_feasibility.decision: PASS only when integrity, convergence, causality, all ranking/fidelity thresholds, and latency pass.

strict_predictor_replacement.decision: A descriptive stronger replacement claim; not required to trigger Stage B, but report independently.

optional_uniform_ablation.purpose: diagnose whether later-horizon weighting transfers as a loss effect on LeWM

decision_levels.predictor_feasibility: GO only if the predictor feasibility gate passes; this is the terminal decision for the current experiment.
decision_levels.strict_predictor_replacement: GO only if the strict predictor thresholds also pass.
decision_levels.full_cem_viability: NOT RUN by user instruction; no planner-level viability claim is permitted.
decision_levels.claim_boundary: A failed relative or strict gate is a frozen-cell NO-GO, not permission to retune weights, width, steps, seeds, or candidate banks.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_predictor_feasibility_pass: Under the pinned official LeWM PushT predictor contract, the specified compact h256 horizon-weighted recurrent student is feasible on the frozen predictor-level held-out protocol.
claim_boundary.allowed_if_strict_predictor_replacement_: The student satisfies the stronger frozen predictor-level ranking, latent-fidelity, causality, and latency thresholds on this LeWM PushT cell.
claim_boundary.allowed_if_full_cem_viability_pass: On the fixed official LeWM PushT CEM boundary and fixed observations/seeds, the student preserves the registered first-action/elite behavior thresholds while reducing full-solve latency.
forbidden: claim that LeWM and DINO-WM weights are interchangeable
selection of step500 or step1000 after observing results

execution_constraints.checkpoint_return: No checkpoint retrieval is required as the primary result artifact.
